flags.name: DFIntTaskSchedulerTargetFps
flags.description: Sets the target frame rate. Roblox may ignore this on some configurations. 9999 = uncapped.

flags.name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistance
flags.description: Master LOD culling distance for CSG models. Lower values improve FPS by reducing distant geometry detail.

flags.name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL12
flags.description: LOD distance for the first transition tier. Affects medium-distance geometry.

flags.name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL23
flags.description: LOD distance for the second transition tier.

flags.name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL34
flags.description: LOD distance for the third transition tier.

flags.name: FFlagDebugSkyGray
flags.description: Overrides the skybox to a flat gray color and removes atmospheric stars. Can improve FPS in sky-heavy games.

flags.name: FFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled
flags.description: Enables the texture quality override below. Must be true for DFIntTextureQualityOverride to take effect.

flags.name: DFIntTextureQualityOverride
flags.description: Forces texture quality. 0 = lowest (fastest), 3 = highest (best visuals).

flags.name: FIntFRMMaxGrassDistance
flags.description: Maximum distance for grass rendering. 0 disables grass entirely.

flags.name: DFIntDebugFRMQualityLevelOverride
flags.description: Forces a global RenderQuality level. Lower = faster, higher = better visuals.

flags.name: DFFlagDebugPauseVoxelizer
flags.description: Pauses the voxelizer after the initial load. Can reduce stutter in large worlds.

flags.name: FFlagDisablePostFx
flags.description: Disables post-processing effects (bloom, DoF, color grading). Notable FPS gain on low-end GPUs.

flags.name: FIntDebugForceMSAASamples
flags.description: Forces MSAA anti-aliasing samples. Higher values smooth edges but reduce FPS.

flags.name: DFIntDebugRestrictGUITimeAsync
flags.description: DEPRECATED. Restricted GUI timing. Flag may cause UI freezes.

presets.name: Low-End / VRAM Crash Fix
presets.author: Velo Team
presets.description: Best for integrated graphics or GPUs with less than 4GB VRAM. Prioritizes stability over visuals.

presets.name: Maximum FPS (Aggressive)
presets.author: Velo Team
presets.description: Disables most visual effects. Best for competitive play or very low-end hardware.

presets.name: Balanced (Recommended)
presets.author: Velo Team
presets.description: A safe middle-ground. Moderate visual reductions for a solid FPS gain without making the game look bad.
